ceu: ✦ The conjunction between Mars and Jupiter

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: A day to feel part of something bigger. Call someone you have not spoken to in a while.
From {H:1794950366000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to rest and your inner life.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on pleasure, creativity and romance. The energy is all in one place: use it with intention.
s.d: Send a message to a friend you miss.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: The Moon passes through your area of career and puts your goals in plain sight. Show what you are capable of.
From {H:1794950366000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to friends and plans for the future.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on home and family. Listen to what this area has been asking of you for a while.
s.d: Update your CV or your professional profile.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: Today faith and optimism grow stronger. A book, an inspiring conversation or a travel plan will do you good.
From {H:1794950366000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to your career and your goals.

Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on conversations, contacts and short trips. What you do here today has more strength than usual.
s.d: Plan a little getaway, even if it is only for next month.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: With the Moon in your house of sharing, matters of joint money or of trust call for clarity.
From {H:1794950366000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to study, travel and broad horizons.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on your money and what you value. A decision made today will stand on firm ground.
s.d: Let someone help you: receiving is also a virtue.

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: The Moon shows you, in others, what you need to see in yourself. A day of lessons shared by two.
From {H:1794950366000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to intimacy and what you share with others.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on your image and your personal energy. Focus, and leave the rest for tomorrow.
s.d: Listen to the end before you answer.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: It is a day of service and usefulness: helping someone at work also helps you.
From {H:1794950366000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to relationships and partnerships.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on rest and your inner life. The sky points the way: all you have to do is follow it.
s.d: Lay out tomorrow's clothes and bag tonight.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: The Moon passes through your area of pleasure and creativity. Allow yourself to do something just because you enjoy it.
From {H:1794950366000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to routine, daily work and health.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on friends and plans for the future. A new beginning may be born from here.
s.d: Plan a romantic moment, even a simple one.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.
From {H:1794950366000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to pleasure, creativity and romance.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on your career and your goals. This is where your strength lies today.
s.d: Make your bedroom a place of rest: less clutter, more peace.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.
From {H:1794950366000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to home and family.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on study, travel and broad horizons. Put your willpower at the service of what matters.
s.d: Write an idea down on paper before it slips away.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.
From {H:1794950366000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to conversations, contacts and short trips.

Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on intimacy and what you share with others. Everything is concentrated in one place, so give it your full attention.
s.d: Make a list of what you have already achieved and give thanks.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.
From {H:1794950366000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to your money and what you value.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on relationships and partnerships. Do not scatter yourself: one goal at a time.
s.d: Look at yourself in the mirror with the tenderness you show the people you love.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.
From {H:1794950366000}, the Moon moves into {S:11} and the focus shifts to your image and your personal energy.
Mars and Jupiter are together in {S:4}: courage and initiative, confidence and opportunities, all focused on routine, daily work and health. It is a good day to start something in this area.
s.d: Sleep a little longer, if you can.
